What I actually want to know: Out of curiosity, how many events does the Botanical Garden in Arad host? Verify the claim that Hiroshi teaches geography.

Cheers, and have a nice evening.

question:
Thanks for your patience with all my questions. An ID card is required for a residence certificate. Julien isn't married to Hyun-woo. It has been a hectic week on my side.

A criminal record certificate is required for a building permit; a work permit requires a medical certificate. A driving licence does not require a land title extract; a birth certificate is required for a passport. Vikram intends to attend the regional chess tournament. Oluwaseun Eze is on the Arad Falcons. Harry is enrolled at the Iași Language School.

Linh wants to learn history, and Adaeze wants to learn Spanish. Ms Hughes works at Tisa Textiles. Larissa has a job at Greenline Transport; Olena does not work at Atelier Lazăr. Mr Clarke doesn't play for Rapid Lviv, and Vlad does not play for Constanța United. The flat on Mihai Viteazu Street doesn't belong to Tatiana. Plus, the blue van belongs to Burak. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help.

Mr Navarro visits Hanoi. Ingrid plans to go to the spring book fair and Cosmin plans to go to the charity run. Let me give you some background first.

Delta Print supplies Atelier Varga, and Orion Robotics buys from Plovdiv Logistics. Rafael Oliveira doesn't plan to go to the photography workshop. Tariq wants to learn biology. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Vasile is the coach of the Pitești Falcons and Anca isn't the coach of the Lyon Wolves. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. A fire safety approval is issued by the Nairobi Land Office. The bakery on the corner belongs to Xiaoling.

Tampere Logistics supplies Vertex Analytics and Carpathia Energy buys from Montreal Logistics. Chloe is not married to Ms Tanaka; Mei is the spouse of Kamau Mwangi. Corina is the author of Notes from the Night Train and Winter in Maramureș was written by Ms Pătrașcu. Dragoș Voicu does not coach Târgu Mureș United.

The Bistrița Language School is not based in Alexandria and Botoșani Technical College is based in Buzău. Carmen works at Iordache & Partners. Plus, Mr Girard has a job at Brightfield Foods. The Tuesday board meeting is held at the Porto Arena and the Botanical Garden in Timișoara does not host the product launch.

Things I still have to do today:
- finish the slides
- buy groceries
- answer my emails
- book the train tickets

So, my questions: Verify the claim that Constantin is the coach of Olimpia Slatina. Where was the code review session held? True or false: Lucía is employed by Blue Harbor Media. Quick one: how many people are allergic to strawberries? Why was the town hall debate postponed? I wonder where the Zalău Arena is based.

question:
It has been a hectic week on my side. Astrid teaches geography; Samuel gives classes in chemistry. Paula works for Blue Harbor Media. Nordwind Systems is in Bacău. Yuki is not treated by Camille; Mr Toma is treated by Achieng Odhiambo. Olena plans to study mathematics.

The Oradea Dental Practice is in Constanța. The backup cluster relies on the payments gateway, and the booking app depends on the search index. Notes from the Night Train was not written by Ion, and The Quiet Harbour was written by Hiroshi Watanabe. A tax clearance certificate isn't issued by the Iași Tax Office. Andreea works under Dariush, and Priya does not work under Réka.

The recording studio belongs to Larissa, and the plot of land by the river belongs to Haruka. Hassan is the boss of Harry Wilson, and Burak works under Ms Wilson. Mathieu is married to Victor Popescu. Irina does not maintain the billing service, and Jack is responsible for the mail server. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest.

The Passport Office in Cluj-Napoca is based in Călărași. Ilinca Dobre has a job at Diaconu & Partners and Kostas is not employed by Atelier Vlădescu. Olivia maintains the login service. Plus, Omar Nasser is responsible for the analytics pipeline. A work permit isn't issued by the Passport Office in Lagos.

Anna-Lena is the author of The Salt Road. Raluca Oprea intends to attend the product launch and Daria intends to attend the Tuesday board meeting. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help.

A residence certificate requires a criminal record certificate, and an ID card is required for a building permit. Rachel teaches Spanish; Laura Taylor doesn't give classes in physics. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me. Carmen has an allergy to latex.

Elena manages Katalin. Youssef has an allergy to penicillin. Plus, Kaveh is allergic to shellfish. A land title extract is required for a passport. Slatina Logistics doesn't carry herbal tea. Pablo wants to learn piano.

Seo-yeon is enrolled at the Timișoara Language School. Atelier Tóth carries second-hand laptops, and Atelier Munteanu doesn't carry sourdough bread. Alina is employed by Vaslui Logistics. Taras is enrolled at Pitești Technical College. Plus, Liam studies at Orhei Arts High School. Doinița is married to Wei.

Ana has an allergy to strawberries.

Things I still have to do today:
- book the train tickets
- pay the phone bill
- call the plumber

So, my questions: True or false: the Passport Office in Târgu Mureș doesn't issue a driving licence. Any idea when Marius Ciobanu was the coach of Olimpia Debrecen? Any idea how long Mr Mansour was the owner of the blue van? Apart from Jessica, I wonder who plays for the Arad Wolves.

- buy groceries

Talk soon!
